record.question: Article 22(2) states that any person who is arrested and detained must be produced before the nearest magistrate within ________ of their arrest, excluding the time required for transportation. This provision is aimed at preventing arbitrary detention and ensuring that the detained person is produced before a judicial authority within a reasonable time.
